name: Time Lord Regeneration
oracle_text: Until end of turn, target Time Lord you control gains "When this creature dies, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a Time Lord creature card. Put that card onto the battlefield and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order."
blocked_sentences: Until end of turn, target Time Lord you control gains "When this creature dies, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a Time Lord creature card. Put that card onto the battlefield and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order."

needs.what: the type-line split keeping "Time Lord" one creature type (205.3m): proxy.split_type_line splits subtypes on whitespace, so every Time Lord in the pool carries the subtypes Time and Lord and a selector naming "Time Lord" matches none of them
needs.why_existing_wont_do: the target selector {"subtypes": ["Time Lord"]} compiles, but no permanent ever has that subtype, so the spell never has a legal target; naming "Time" or "Lord" alone would match the wrong things
